text.body:
|| {candrāvalokanam} ||
hariḥ oṃ ||
maheśvara uvāca(-)
antarlakṣyaṃ tvahirdṛṣṭirnimeṣonmeṣa varjitam | iyaṃ sā śāmbhavī mudrā sarvanteṣu gopitā || 1 ||
antarlakṣya vilīna cittapavano yogī yadā vartate | dṛṣṭyā niścala(tara)yā bahirathaḥ paśyanna payet sadā |
mudreyaṃ khalu khecarī bhavati sā yuktā prasādādguroḥ | śūnyāśūnya vivarjitaṃ sphurati cet tatvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam ||
ardhodghaṭitalocana sthiramanā nāsāgra datte kṣaṇaḥ candrārkāvapi līnatāmupagatau niṣpandarūpaṃ vapuḥ | jyotīrūpamaśeṣabāhyarahitaṃ dedīpyamānaṃ paraṃ tatvaṃ tat padameti yat tu paramaṃ vācyaṃ kimātrādhikam ||
yasmillaye'ti garbhasye'ntentarlaya vedite | layaḥ so'pi ca vijñeyastuṣṭena guruṇā yutaḥ ||
yā citissarvabhūtānām udayavyayasākṣiṇī | tāṃ citiṃ paśya kāyasyāṃ pūrṇānandaghanāmṛtām ||
śivo'nyatramano'nyatra śaktiranyatramārutaḥ | na siddhyati varārohe kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||
jñānaṃ kuto manasi jīvati devi yāvat prāṇe'pi jīvati mano mriyatena yāvat |
prāṇo mano dvayamidaṃ vilayaṃ prayāti mokṣaṃ sa gacchati naro na kathañcidanyaḥ ||
sayogeṣu viyogeṣu aṇubīja sukhādikam | yaḥ kuryād dṛṣṭi liṅgeṣu nā sāvadhānonirantaram ||
yatra dṛṣṭirmanastatra bhūtendriya sanātanam | sā śaktissa hi bhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭirlakṣye layaṃgatā ||
yatra dṛṣṭirmanaḥsyairyaṃ tatra caiva hi mārutaḥ | ayaṃ kopi bhavedevaṃ tasyāragai siddhasammataḥ ||
cakṣuragrasthito kāraṃ sabāhyābhyantara sthitam | dṛśyate cakṣuragre'pi cakṣuvaiva na paśyati ||
cakṣuragra sthito nityaṃ visphuranyomaṇiryathā | taṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāpakaṃ śambhuṃ bhavabandhaiḥ pramucyate ||
ātma jyotirmano jyotirjyotiścakṣurna paśyati | sābāhyābhyantaraṃ jyotiḥ sa jyotiśśivaḥ ucyate ||
yāvannaiva praviśati caranmāruto madhyamārge yāvadbindurna bhavati dṛḍhaḥ prāṇavāta prabuddhaḥ | yāvadvo (* * *) sadṛśa sarasaṃ jāyate nonmanatvaṃ tāvatsarvaṃ yadi ca vadate dambhamithyā pralāpaḥ ||
nityābhyāsarataḥ kāścid gurubhaktaśca niścalaḥ | sahajaṃ yo na jānāti andhavatsa pravartate ||
amāvāsyā ca pratipat paurṇamāsī ca gopyate | kāmaṃ viṣaṃ nirañjānāt (* * * *) sarvatra pariveśitā ||
agre prema yutā pālyā lokānāṃ bhramaṇāyate | yathā bhūtaṃ na jānaṃti mithyādambheṇa daṃbhitāḥ ||
amāvāsyā ca pratipat paurṇamāsī ca gopyate | kāmaṃ viṣaṃ nirañjanaṃ sarvasyo parisaṃsthitam ||
matsyendra uvāca(-)
amāvāsyā ca pratipat paurṇamāsī ca śaṅkara | kathaṃ sā bhaṇyate saṃjñā sarvaṃ vyākhyā hi tatvataḥ ||
īśvara uvāca(-)
pratipaccakṣurunmeṣa amāvāsyāstalocanā | ardhāvalokanaṃ yāvat parṇamāsīṃ vadantitām ||
matsyendraḥ(-)
kāma śabdena kiṃ vācyaṃ viṣeṇāpi kimucyate | nirañjanasvabhāvaḥ kaḥ etadākhyā hi tatvataḥ ||
īśvaraḥ(-)
pratipadgrasate kālaṃ mamāvāsyā tathaiva ca | pa (* * *) sthirīkṛtya panthā bhavati nānyathā ||
kāmena viṣayākāṅkṣā viṣāt kāmasya tallayaḥ | dvāvetau santyajennityaṃ nirañjanamupāśrayet || aparaḥ santyajetsarvaṃ yadīcchedātmanohitam ||
anyathāmaraṇañcaiva bhuktatvāt (* * *) ni ca | śakti madhye manaḥ kṛtvā manaḥ śaktestu madhyagam |
manasā mana ālokya taddhyāyet paramaṃ padam ||
matsyendraḥ(-)
bījaḥ caiva kimākhyātaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bindulakṣaṇam | kathañcotpadyate binduretadākhyāhi tatvataḥ ||
īśvaraḥ(-)
mana eva hi bījaścotpatti sthiti kāraṇam | manasotpadyate binduryathā kṣīraṃ ghṛtātmakam ||
matsyendraḥ(-)
śikhā nagāgra paryantaṃ vyāpitañca sukhāsukham | dravate ghaṇṭikācchidraṃ bandhanaṃ tasya kīdṛśam ||
īśvaraḥ(-)
na ca bandhanamadhyasthaṃ na caikaraṇamānasam |
candrāt madhya śaktiryatra syā tatra bandhanam | jñātvā suṣumnā sadbhedaṃ kṛtvā vāmuñca madhyagam ||
kṛtvā sā vaindave sthāne ghrāṇarandhre nirodhayet |
matsyendraḥ(-)
vāsubinduḥ samākhyātaḥ tatvaṃ prakṛtimeva ca ||
ṣaṭcakrāṇi na jānāmi kathayasva prasīdame |
īśvaraḥ(-)
ādhārañca svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ tṛtīyakam ||
anāhataṃ viśuddhañcājñācakraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhakam | athāraṃ gudamityuktaṃ svādhiṣṭhāñca liṅgakam ||
maṇipūraṃ nābhideśe hṛdayasthamanāhatam | viśuddhaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe cājñācakraṃ ca mastake ||
ṣaṭcakrāṇi parijñāya praviśed dhruvamaṇḍale | praviśedvāyumākṛṣya tathairvordhve niyojayet ||
evaṃ samabhyasettāvadyo brahmāṇḍamayo bhavet | vāyurbindustathā cakraṃ citte citte yuktaṃ samabhyaset ||
samādhinaikena samaṃmamṛtaṃ yānti yoginaḥ | yathāgnirdāru madhyastho vottiṣṭhenmathane vinā ||
tathaivābhyāsa yogena jñānadīptirna caiva hi | ghaṭamadhye yathā dīpo bāhye naiva prakāśayet ||
(* * *) smin gate caiva dīpajvālāvabhāsate | svabhāvaṃ ghaṭamityuktaṃ dīpameva hi tatpadam | guruvākyā (* * *) nna brahma jñānaṃ sphuṭī bhavet ||
karṇadhāraṃ guruṃ prāpya kṛtvā sūkṣmāntarāṇi ca | abhyāsa vāhanā saktāstaranti bhavasāgaram ||
matsyendra uvāca(-)
tavapāda prasādena mukto'haṃ bhavabandhanāt | tvaṃ gatirdeva deveśa nānyathā me'stiśaṅkara ||
śrutvāmatsendra vāktyantu praviṣṭo bhagavān śivaḥ | gaccha putra pṛthivyāṃtvaṃ trailokyaṃ coddhariṣyasi ||
[iti maheśvareṇaviracitaṃ candrāvalokanam sampūrṇaṃ] ||
|| śrīgurunāthāya namaḥ ||
